args.description: One compact square SETTINGS button sprite only, centered within a 64x64 transparent canvas, the drawn button occupies exactly 52x52 pixels with SIX transparent pixels of padding around it. Forged silver royal relic UI for a crisp chunky mobile pixel-art game. Square silhouette with four short clipped 45-degree corners. A substantial silver six-pixel bevel, pale silver upper-left edges, cool lavender-gray lower-right planes, strong dark outline. Flat near-black purple recessed interior. A simple pale silver eight-tooth gear exactly centered with a large dark circular hole. Four tiny warm gold diamond studs integrated into the four corners, no gold on the main rails. 85 percent silver, 15 percent gold jewelry accents. Connected broad clean flat clusters, no noise or cracks, no blur or antialiasing. It must be a square icon button, never a rectangle, leave all outer six pixels transparent.

style_image.usage_description: Native pixel rendering and clear top-left shading only.
